semantics.retention_rule: Audit retention policy is explicit and separate from source-data retention.
semantics.source_purge_rule: Purging source data does not silently purge required audit evidence.
semantics.payload_rule: Audit evidence must not preserve unnecessary source payload beyond allowed audit purpose.
semantics.hash_rule: Integrity/hash/chain evidence remains verifiable across archive/retention.
semantics.hold_rule: Applicable legal/compliance holds may block audit purge explicitly.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expired audit evidence follows explicit archive/purge policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Retention status grants no access authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
